name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is an 'if ... must also ...' sentence, which maps to a hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open); the key pickup is a condition, not an unconditional command, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
